notes.title: Version 0.1.14-alpha
notes.notes:
Map Changes
Several existing rooms within the facility have been revamped, and a few new ones have been introduced. (Please note many of these rooms are still very much so work-in-progress. Feedback on them is appreciated!)

Breakable Glass has been introduced in some of these rooms.

A new vertical door type has been introduced.
Physics Props
Over 100 new physics props have been introduced.

These props can be found around the facility, or spawned via a menu in the admin panel.

Some props can be damaged and destroyed (currently only the explosive barrel.)
Main Menu Redesign
The main menu is now in an office setting, with the server list and options displayed on a monitor.

Please note the design is not final, we just wanted to get this done quickly for the playtest.
SCP-173 Redesign
SCP-173 has received a new model and sound effects.

Gameplay changes will be coming in a future update.
Item Improvements
Keycard ranks have been revamped, and more of them can be found around the facility. (Mainly LCZ.)

The Medkit has received a new model.

Grenades are red now.

You can now aim with the Short Range SMG.
New Sounds & Music
HCZ and LCZ doors have received new sound effects.

Tesla Gates have received powerful new zapping sounds.

The Short Range SMG and Pistol have received new gunshot sounds.

All SCPs (except 457) have received stingers and chase themes.

Surface Zone has a new ambient track.

MTF have a new spawn wave theme.
